description: This file contains unit tests for the NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer, which checks for improper use of ref, out, and in parameters in Orleans grain interface methods. It uses Xunit for testing and references Microsoft.CodeAnalysis and Orleans.Analyzers.

classes.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer, ensuring it correctly identifies improper ref/out parameters in Orleans grain interface methods and allows valid cases.

methods.name: NoRefParamsAllowedInGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Tests that ref parameters in grain interface methods are correctly flagged as diagnostics.

methods.name: NoOutParamsAllowedInGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Tests that out parameters in grain interface methods are correctly flagged as diagnostics.

methods.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerInClass
methods.description: Tests multiple ref/out parameter violations in class implementations of grain interfaces.

methods.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerNoError
methods.description: Ensures that normal parameters in grain interface methods do not produce diagnostics.

methods.name: OutAndRefParamsAllowedInStaticGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Verifies that static interface methods with ref/out parameters are allowed and do not produce diagnostics.
